eps.o: As retirement looms, John Cena seeks an iconic — and explosive — exit from the ring. A new power couple threatens Seth Rollins and Becky Lynch's reign.
WWE's past, present and future collide during John Cena's farewell match. "The Vision" is compromised by injuries, forcing the writers' room to pivot.
With Seth Rollins out, the Royal Rumble rests on WWE's next generation. Oba Femi and Trick Williams make electric debuts; Liv Morgan earns a major win.
Chicago's own CM Punk and AJ Lee push through heartbreak to dominate in the Elimination Chamber. Stephanie Vaquer recalls her long road to the WWE.
Championship titles, epic comebacks and unfinished business hang in the balance as the Superstars give it all they have for WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas.
